reviews.title: Good, not great.
reviews.comment: Good case. Was for my daughters build and she loves it. But, I am concern on how to keep the  dust out from the bottom. it pulls air up from the bottom, So I may have to reverse the flow and pull air from the top and side and out from the back and bottom if there is a dust issue. A little flimsier that I'd like it to be, but not too bad.
reviews.author: Matt
